rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an outcome that is surprisingly contrary to expectations.

example.english: They unexpectedly finished the report in an hour.
example.traditional: 佢竟然一個鐘頭就做完份報告。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ging2 jin4 jat1 go3 zung1 tau4 zau6 zou6 jyun4 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the speaker personally did not anticipate the outcome.

example.english: I unexpectedly managed to get tickets so quickly.
example.traditional: 我估唔到咁快就買到飛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 m4 dou2 gam3 faai3 zau6 maai5 dou2 fei1

rows.note: Use this in a narrative turn meaning that events unexpectedly turned out differently from what was just expected.

example.english: I thought the bus still had seats, but unexpectedly it was full as soon as I got on.
example.traditional: 我以為架巴士仲有位，點知一上車就滿座。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 wai4 gaa3 baa1 si2 zung6 jau5 wai2 dim2 zi1 jat1 soeng5 ce1 zau6 mun5 zo6
